P01.rationale: There are no human portraits or founder images on this page; it consists entirely of text and abstract typography.

P05.rationale: The layout contains no case studies with client portraits; the only imagery is a large decorative numeral '11' at the bottom.

P07.rationale: There are no social-proof elements such as press logos, rating cards, or review grids present on this page.

P10.rationale: A massive, oversized decorative numeral '11' is used as a background element to anchor the bottom of the layout.

P11.rationale: There are no data visualizations, charts, or before/after graphics; the page relies solely on text blocks and typography.

P12.rationale: The page is a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with substantial text columns and large headlines.

P13.rationale: A solid, deep blue background texture provides an appropriate atmosphere for the white typography.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for text readability treatments.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (like phones or laptops) are shown in the composition.

N07.rationale: The imagery is not generic stock; it consists of specific typographic elements and a solid color background appropriate to the editorial theme.

N08.rationale: There are minimal dead spaces as the text blocks fill most of the page, though there is some negative space around the central columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim because there are no photographs overlaid with text in this layout.
